items.title: Full-Stack Mobile Engineer - Blued
items.summary: A mobile engineer role for the product team behind StudyIn, Japan’s No. 1 overseas education travel service. The role involves developing mobile apps and backend APIs, and planning/implementing AI agents.

items.title: Senior Software Engineer (Go), API Platform Department at Money Forward
items.summary: Money Forward is hiring a Senior Software Engineer for their API Platform Department in Kyoto. This Go-focused role supports visa sponsorship and relocation to Japan with partial remote work.
